author: Mark Atwood
text: Recommendation ratified after no human pushback in ~58 hours (committed 2026-05-15T03:55Z, ratified 2026-05-17T13Z): option (c) — doc-only hardening. Add a Gotchas section to README and a doc-comment block on each affected struct (Calendar, CryptoKey, Directory, Link, Media, plus the 'at-least-one' invariants on Name, Organization, SpeakToAs, OnlineService, Address, Author) cross-referencing the lib.rs:16-23 design statement. De-labeling for the autonomous frontier.
